comment: The man.  No homework or tests.  Only 3, 4-6 page, papers the entire semester.  There are assigned readings, but you can get away with not doing them. Easy A if you can write fairly well. Definitely recommended.

I love history, and he really knows his stuff. Most of his lectures are a mix between a recap of the readings and an intro to...well, the next readings. The good news is that the books he chose for the class are very interesting, so his lectures aren't too bad. As the other reviewer said, his jokes ARE a bit corny; he's still funny though.

You will be bored and you will fall asleep lol but you will get a decent grade. Not much work to do in the class, you only have two or three papers. He is a nice guy, but his voice is pretty annoying. He is cool and tries to be funny, so laugh at his corny jokes.
